question: What is constant along an isoquant curve?
solution:
The correct answer is **'__Level of output__'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• An isoquant curve is a concave-shaped line on a graph, used in the study of microeconomics,** that charts all the factors, or inputs, that produce a specified level of output.**
 
• This graph is used as a metric for the influence that the inputs—most commonly, capital and labor—have on the obtainable level of output or production.

 [IMAGE: https://businessjargons.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/12/convex-iso-quant-curve.jpg]
